一张截图，整理成你的私人活动卡。: Turn a screenshot into your own event card.
把截图变成一次出发: From screenshot to something to do
仅自己可见，已保存到你的账号。: Private to you, saved to your account.
仅保存在此浏览器，请导出日历留一份。: Saved only in this browser. Export to your calendar to keep a copy.
点击识别后，图片会交给 AI 整理；确认后仅保存活动文字。: When you select Read event, AI will process the image. Only the event text is saved after you confirm.
正在读活动名称、日期和地点…: Reading the event name, date and location…
对照原图，检查日期和地点。: Check the date and location against the original.
这是 AI 整理的草稿，空白或不准确的地方请补充。: This is an AI draft. Fill in anything missing and correct any mistakes.
填写活动名称和完整日期，就可以保存。: Add an event name and full date to save it.
时间按湾区当地时间；未填时间时，只保存日期提醒。: Times use Bay Area local time. Leave times blank for a date-only reminder.
尚未确认完整日期，请核对年份后填写。: The full date is missing. Check the year before filling it in.
这个日期已经过去，请确认是否选对年份。: This date is in the past. Check that the year is correct.
我已核对活动名称、日期和地点。: I have checked the event name, date and location.
仅自己可见，保存到我的这周。: Private to you, saved in My Week.
无需登录，仅保存在此浏览器。: No sign-in needed. Saved only in this browser.
从私人日程中移除这场活动？: Remove this event from your private schedule?
仅自己可见，活动信息以主办方最新说明为准。: Private to you. Check with the organizer for the latest details.
仅保存在此浏览器，活动信息以主办方最新说明为准。: Saved only in this browser. Check with the organizer for the latest details.
把喜欢的活动截图放进来，日期、地点和日历提醒就能留在一起。: Import an event screenshot to keep its date, location and calendar reminder together.
请选择不超过 10 MB 的 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 图片。: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 10 MB.
图片压缩后仍过大，请裁剪到活动信息区域后重试。: The image is still too large. Crop to the event details and try again.
这张图片暂时无法读取，请换一张图片或手动填写。: This image could not be read. Try another image or enter the details manually.
识别请求较多，请稍后重试，也可以手动填写。: Too many requests. Try again later or enter the details manually.
暂时无法识别这张图片。可以重试，或直接手动填写。: This image could not be processed. Try again or enter the details manually.
活动记录暂时无法读取，请重新加载。: Your saved events could not be loaded. Please reload them.
日程已在别处更新，请核对后再次保存。你填写的内容仍保留。: Your schedule changed elsewhere. Check the latest events and save again. Your draft is still here.
保存失败，内容仍保留。请检查连接或浏览器存储后重试。: Could not save. Your draft is still here. Check your connection or browser storage and try again.
请确认活动的完整日期，包括年份。: Confirm the complete event date, including the year.
请检查时间、链接和文字长度。来源链接需以 https:// 开头。: Check the times, link and text lengths. Source links must start with https://.
结束时间应晚于开始时间；跨日活动请按每天分别记录。: The end time must be after the start time. Add a separate entry for each day of a multi-day event.
这场活动已在你的日程里。: This event is already in your schedule.
最多保存 60 场私人活动，请先整理已结束的活动。: You can save up to 60 private events. Remove some past events first.
